subject: LAB-012
check: Publication, privacy, rights, walkthrough, and availability review
steps: Read the fixture README, module and host sources, ticket, spec, and linked source/permission/test boundaries
Re-read Vision and FoundationModels interfaces in the installed macOS SDK using grep through labr; first attempt using rg failed because it is not installed on the build host
Review the Apple RecognizeTextRequest structured documentation response and compare OS availability
Review all ticket artifacts for original input, labels separating replay and live integration, private data, and unsupported claims

outcome.detail: The fixture is original geometric artwork with the recorded 115-byte hash. All test text is synthetic; no accounts, real photos, credentials, or customer material were used. No screenshots, recordings, or export archives were produced. The walkthrough labels fixture/session execution and leaves camera, live model, system visual search, physical iPhone/iPad, and assistive-technology passes unverified. Module review found no upload or URL-opening route. Apply intentionally persists recognized text in the local note; other explicitly chosen exports may carry it. SDK request and image-attachment gates match the source ledger.

limitations: Static review is not runtime network interception or proof that a system visual-search service stays local. Only this app module is reviewed.
The documentation reader could not retrieve Visual Intelligence and Foundation Models Markdown; no refreshed behavior claim relies on those failed responses.
Accessibility review is source-only and records missing Mac shortcuts, unpinned iPhone Apply, and absent explicit status announcements.
No visual screenshots or generated exports exist to approve; this review covers original fixture and metadata-only evidence.
